configuration.csmModules.defaultModuleRo: Default relative directory used when initializing local CSM module management for a repository that does not already have a csm-modules.yaml file.
configuration.csmModules.hiddenTopics.de: Module repository topics to hide from the CSM Modules sidebar badges, tree tooltips, and local search text.
configuration.csmModules.dedup.enabled.d: Enable collapsing of consecutive duplicate log messages in .csmlog files.
configuration.csmModules.dedup.minRepeat: Minimum number of consecutive identical log messages required to create a foldable group (minimum 2). Messages are matched loosely — numeric parameters (e.g. connection attempt counters) are ignored.
configuration.csmModules.dedup.multiLine: Detect and collapse multi-line repeating log blocks (e.g. a 5-line UI update cycle that repeats every second).
Automatically fold all detected duplicate groups when opening a .csmlog file.
